WITH RECURSIVE walk(depth, idx) AS (
            SELECT 0, idx FROM methods WHERE scope=%s AND idx=%s
            UNION
            SELECT walk.depth + 1, calls.target
            FROM walk JOIN calls ON calls.scope=%s AND calls.relation=%s AND calls.source=walk.idx
            WHERE walk.depth < %s
        ) SELECT DISTINCT idx FROM walk WHERE depth > 0 AND idx <> %s ORDER BY idx
